name: report_step2_output
description: Report the list of candidate theoretical directions matched in step 2 (candidate_theory_directions, each with theory_name and relevance_rationale), used to scope step 3's retrieval; does not judge whether a gap exists, does not require already-traceable literature.

CandidateTheoryDirection.description:
A single candidate theoretical direction produced by step 2. Only scopes "which direction to
look in," without judging whether a gap exists or requiring already-traceable literature — that's
step 3's job.

relevance_rationale.description: A preliminary explanation of why this direction might be relevant to the phenomenon — must point to which specific part of the phenomenon it corresponds to, not just name the theory
relevance_rationale.title: Relevance Rationale

CandidateTheoryDirection.title: CandidateTheoryDirection

input_schema.description:
The complete structured result step 2's single agent run requires the model to produce: a set of
candidate theoretical directions.

Much simpler than step 1 — a single judgment, with no verification loop needing automatic in-run
retries like the theory-jargon check. min_length=2: doesn't accept turning in just one "most
likely" direction — step 2's value lies precisely in not narrowing to a single direction too early,
letting step 3's retrieval results test which direction actually holds up on their own.

candidate_theory_directions.description: Does not require a single answer — produce several potentially-relevant theoretical directions for step 3 to retrieve and verify one by one
candidate_theory_directions.title: Candidate Theory Directions

input_schema.title: Step2Output
